Manage webhook endpoints

Usage:
  kaab webhooks [command]

Available Commands:
  create      Create an endpoint; its secret is printed once
  deliveries  List an endpoint's deliveries, newest first
  list        List endpoints
  test        Send a ping to an endpoint and show its answer

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for webhooks

Global Flags:
      --base-url string   API base URL (KAAB_BASE_URL; https://api.kaab.ist/v1 by default)
      --json              print the API's JSON instead of a table
      --profile string    profile to use (KAAB_PROFILE; the current profile by default)
      --test              use the profile's test-mode key (sk_test_)

Use "kaab webhooks [command] --help" for more information about a command.
